entries: I have made terrible choices and I stand by all of them.
The jungle took everything from me. Tonight I take it back.
You were all thinking it. I just had the courage to say it.
I didn't come here to make friends. I came here to hydrate.
History will remember what happened here tonight.
Somewhere out there, my ex is telling this exact story wrong.
One day this will all be a podcast.
My therapist warned me about nights like this.
This is my villain origin story.
Tell my group chat I loved them.
I would have gotten away with it, too.
Every group has a weak link. I have made my peace with being ours.
No one believes me, but I used to be responsible.
This isn't a cry for help. This is a victory lap.
I didn't choose the chaos. The chaos chose me.
Let it be known that I saw this coming and said nothing.
I have never been more certain of anything in my life, and I am certain of nothing.
Somewhere, a younger version of me is disappointed. The rest of me is thriving.
I regret nothing. I remember very little. Both are fine.
Future me is going to have some questions.
Somewhere, someone is still thinking about the way I said goodnight.
I have never once regretted an eyebrow raise.
They didn't stand a chance and neither did I.
I came here looking for trouble, and trouble found me first.
Nobody warned them what happens when I get comfortable.
